name: portscannerpractice
title: PortScannerPractice
description: Create a basic port scanner program for cybersecurity practice.
summary: A modular, educational Python port scanner for cybersecurity practice featuring TCP connect scanning, multi-threaded execution, banner grabbing, service identification, exportable scan reports, and interactive learning quizzes.

plan.purpose: Application entry point supporting command-line execution flags and interactive console mode.
Core port scanning engine handling socket connection tests, concurrent execution, timeout management, banner grabbing, and host reachability checks.
Database of common network ports, associated service names, protocol details, and educational security implications.
Export module for formatting and saving scan results into JSON, CSV, and human-readable text reports.
Interactive port identification quiz and study helper to reinforce cybersecurity fundamentals.
Command-line interface formatting, argument parsing, and interactive menu system.
Comprehensive user guide containing ethical disclaimer, usage instructions, CLI arguments, and practice scenarios.
